name: Global segment taxonomy -- Opal-level AUA split by delivery type
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-29 voice substrate for a new backend-only Global view in Model Portfolios. The project defines a product-axis taxonomy that sits above the existing MDPF taxonomy at the Opal aggregate only: ETF Models, SMA Strategies, Custom Models, and Non-Model residual. It creates the segment_v1 backend contract and work plan without changing per-firm or per-advisor served views.

standing_guards: Backend only. No frontend work belongs in this project.
Global-only. Do not change per-firm or per-advisor served views under this project.
Keep the existing A4 per-firm two-term residual invariant unless Andrew explicitly changes scope.
Every segment artifact must carry axis: segment_v1 and scope: global.
Bind segment membership to model_id, never display_name, model_key, or bare ETF ticker strings.
Incomplete segment inputs are null or absent, never fabricated zeroes; non_model is derived and null when any subtrahend is incomplete.
Unclassified members are loud first-class output, not silently absorbed by non_model.
Do not write org/missions directly; the mission register is MSTR-owned and machine-derived.
